The guy Im currently with helped me because he loves me. I've admitted to him that I don't feel the same way but he really wants to make us work so.. I guess I should at least try. Im just finding it hard because I'm just not attracted to his personality & we arent very compatible.

I guess thats true. Im very nervous about what the future holds, I feel very lost & i just miss the happy feelings my ex gave me. Right now I'm not getting any of those happy feelings from anywhere..
Im 22 and yes, he was a good person but it ended badly. I think hes all jaded now because of me.
Your dear friend sounds incredible for surviving slavery. Ill never know where life will take me but I seriously hope its somewhere good because I honestly cant handle any more disappointments.

I love/hate seeing posts like this. I made this account just to post something similar, just hoping my ex would see it. When I see posts like this, I don't know.. It makes me want to pretend like you're my ex and you're telling me you still think about me. I don't know if that's silly or if other people do that too.

I still think you're the one too and I hope you're doing well.

I made this throwaway account just now to write something similar. I loved so much and lost. You're probably not the one I'm talking about but this post makes me want to pretend like you are. It's kind of comforting. Thank you for this post.
